details.publicNotes:
Prismites are a class of earth elementals composed partially or entirely of crystals and precious gemstones, making them highly sought after by the greedy, the curious, and the scholarly alike. Most prismites have enough experience with selfish treasure hunters to view anyone they come across with suspicion. However, some can be convinced to work for wealthy individuals in exchange for a steady diet of delicious crystals and an opportunity to pummel anyone who would dare assault their homes.

Refulgent prismites are a particularly brilliant variety of prismites, composed of clear or mostly transparent crystals like quartz, diamond, or sapphire. The primal energies of these powerful elementals manifest as light deep within their cores, which these elder elementals weaponize, refracting through their crystalline bodies to dazzle and burn those that would threaten them.

Prismites don't often interact with other elementals and keep amongst their own kind. More typical elementals often find prismites pretentious, insufferable, and overly concerned with appearances.

Flawed Stone

The precious stone composing a refulgent prismite is nowhere near as valuable as the prismite claims it is: the shards of a destroyed prismite reveal themselves to be flawed, worth only the value of the monster parts for a creature of their level. Letting this fact be known would dissuade refulgent prismite hunters, perhaps saving the prismites' lives, but refulgent prismites couldn't bear the disgrace of having their flawed nature known.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 125/275/500 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning, piercing), armor (heavy), perception item, skill items (Athletics, Intimidation, Nature)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, burning barbs, constitution, earth, earth armor, elongating, energy resistant (fire, vitality), fire, fire shield, light, strength, throwing, wild

description.value: The refulgent prismite's crystalline form is attuned to the light that they emit, allowing them to detect creatures that they have bathed in bright light as a precise sense. This ability typically allows them to see in the area of their radiant gleam aura, but its radius can be temporarily extended by the refulgent prismite's other abilities. They lack typical vision, as they can't detect light from other sources.

Trigger The refulgent prismite is within the light radius of another refulgent prismite's Brilliance

Effect The refulgent prismite enhances their ally's brightness. The radius of the fiery emanation increases by 10 feet and the radius of the bright light increases by 100 feet. If this would cause the light radius to include a new refulgent prismite, that prismite can then Refract.

60 feet. A refulgent prismite constantly sheds intense light, making it difficult to look directly at them. Creatures that end their turn within the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save. On a successful save, the creature is temporarily immune to radiant gleam for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled for 1 minute.

The refulgent prismite concentrates their light so severely that it sears flesh, dealing @Damage[8d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:29] save). After using Brilliance, the refulgent prismite shine emits bright light in a 100-foot radius until the end of their next turn. It can't use Brilliance again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Brilliance]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} by a refulgent prismite for 1 minute.

Success The creature is dazzled for 1 round and takes half damage.

Failure The creature is blinded for 1 round and takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature is blinded for 1 minute and takes double damage.
A refulgent prismite can Burrow through earthen matter, including rock. When they do so, they move at their full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of their passing.
